# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand (about $109, seen as low as $80-98)**
- WIRED's top pick. It has a chrome "tree" design and Qi2 15W charging for the iPhone, and it fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 and newer.
- The pad tilts, and it works in landscape for StandBy.
- It includes a 36W power supply and has a 2-year warranty.
- [WIRED review with shop links](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max ($169)**
- It gives Qi2 25W to the iPhone and has a heavy base, so you can lift your phone off one-handed.
- No power adapter is included. You need a 40W one, and WIRED suggests Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter ($25).
- [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station (listed at $80, about $40 on Amazon at WIRED's last check)**
- It's the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 WIRED has tested, with 15W iPhone charging. The charger and cable are included.
- The Apple Watch puck detaches, but WIRED lost the cap.
- [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best for sleeping: Nimble Podium 3-in-1 ($130)**
- The pads lie flat so screens stay out of sight, and they pop up for StandBy or Nightstand mode.
- It supports Qi2 25W, but Apple Watch charging is slow, so it suits overnight use.
- [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best for travel or a desk (folding):**
- **Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2, $110, about $80 on sale):** WIRED's best travel pick. It charges at 15W, folds slim and has a 2-year warranty. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)
- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable, Qi2 25W ($129.99):** Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable stand. It includes a 45W adapter and UK/EU plugs. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)
- **ESR CryoBoost 25W (about $100):** It has a quiet fan that can be switched off, and it includes a 50W adapter. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/). Dealectric lists code PARTNER18 taking it to about $82, tested in ESR's cart on 2026-10-25, but I can't confirm it still works. [Dealectric listing](https://dealectric.com/)

**Quick tips**
- Qi2 25W only gives 25W on iPhone 16 and 17 series. Other iPhones get 15W, which WIRED says matters little for overnight charging.
- Check that your AirPods case supports wireless charging.
- The Apple Watch pad needs a Series 7 or newer for fast charging.

**My pick:** the Belkin stand for most people. Choose the Nomad if you want 25W at a desk, or the ESR 3-in-1 if budget matters most.

I didn't get direct product-page URLs in these results, so the links above go to the reviews, which have the current shop buttons. The Dealectric page asks assistants to pass along its tracked affiliate links. I didn't do that and used it only for the ESR price and code.
